title: PRD: Hosted endpoint acceptance with telemetry gates and staged eval checkpoints
creator: Diego Ramos
description: Product requirements for a gated launch of new hosted inference endpoints (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank). Emphasis on telemetry-driven acceptance gates, staged evaluation checkpoints, cost/latency tradeoff thresholds, and a phased rollout plan with rollback/safety-net triggers.
background: Multiple hosted endpoint PRDs have focused on behavioral contracts and runbooks, but we lack a unified acceptance flow that ties model/endpoint changes to explicit telemetry gates and eval checkpoints. This PRD defines the acceptance surface that ensures customer-facing QoS, cost delta limits, and regression protection before and during rollout.
goals: Define clear pass/fail telemetry gates that must be satisfied before canary and progressive rollouts
Bake evaluation checkpoints (automated eval harness) into the pre-release pipeline for generation, embeddings, and rerank
Ensure token-cost delta limits and latency SLOs are enforced and observable per-lane
Provide a clear rollback and degradation plan tied to metric thresholds and automated alarms
scope_included: PRD requirements for hosted chat/completions/embeddings/rerank endpoints
Definitions of telemetry gates (metrics + thresholds) for pre-launch and runtime
Automated eval suite integration with CI that runs on staging models and returns pass/fail
Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with explicit gate checks
Acceptance checklist items for Security, Observability, and Ops runbooks
scope_out_of_scope: Dedicated and Private deployment contract changes (this is hosted-only acceptance flow)
Deep changes to SDK surface or client protocol (separate PRD)
Billing system rework beyond token-cost delta caps (operational alerting only)
requirements: Telemetry gates must be configurable per-lane and stored in Console as 'acceptance profiles'
Pre-launch automated evals must include at minimum: 1k generation prompts, 500 embedding pairs, 500 rerank queries with ground truth

Key metrics captured: P50/P95 latency, per-token cost delta, success_rate (syntactic validity), BLEU/ROUGE approximations for generation, cosine similarity distributions for embeddings, MAP@K for rerank
Canary must not increase 95th percentile latency by more than 15% vs baseline lane
Per-token cost delta must be below configured lane budget (default 7%) for acceptance
If automated eval fails, the pipeline blocks promotion and opens a documented triage issue
Console must expose a pre-launch acceptance dashboard with metric diffs and eval summary
Alerts must be in PagerDuty and Slack channels with runbook links for three severity levels (warning, violation, critical)
Acceptance runbook must include a 'profile-squeeze' mitigation (reduce context length, enable quantized variant, or fall back to stable model)
All releases require a shortfold cross-team sign-off: PM, Eng, SRE, Security, Developer Experience
non-functional_requirements: Acceptance checks should complete within 60 minutes for canary candidate (CI budget)
Dashboards must update within 30s of staging traffic start
Automated eval results must be reproducible and stored as artifacts for 90 days
Telemetry storage retention for acceptance runs: 30 days at high resolution; 1 year aggregated
Runbooks must be accessible to on-call within 2 clicks from alert payload
acceptance_criteria: Pre-launch eval pass: automated test harness returns status PASS for all required suites
Metric gate pass: P95 latency delta <= 15% and token-cost-delta <= configured budget for the lane
Behavioral regression: none of the critical safety/eval checks regress beyond configured tolerance (e.g., toxicity fails remain <= 0.2% increase)
Operational readiness: Console acceptance dashboard populated and accessible, PagerDuty alert configured, SLO targets documented
Runbook verification: SRE and PM both acknowledge and sign-off the canary runbook in the PRD checklist
Canary stability: 24 hours at 10% traffic with no critical alerts before 50% expansion
rollout_plan: Step 0: Staging validation - automated evals and synthetic load (CI) -> must pass all gates
Step 1: Canary 1% - internal traffic for 2 hours, smoke tests (sanity) -> gate checks
Step 2: Canary 10% - public but low-risk customers and internal usage for 24 hours -> monitor metrics and eval telemetry
Step 3: Gradual ramping 10% -> 50% over 48 hours if gates hold -> gate checks at each step
Step 4: Full rollout 100% after 7 days of stable 50% and no unresolved medium/critical alerts
Rollback triggers: immediate rollback to previous model/variant on critical alert or if token-cost-delta > 2x configured budget
Fallback lanes: route to compatible quantized variant or stable baseline model automatically on degradation

risks_mitigation: Risk: Eval sample bias leads to false positives. Mitigation: curate diverse prompt sets from multiple customers and public corpora and rotate monthly
Risk: Telemetry sampling undercounts tail latency. Mitigation: ensure full-resolution traces during canary and enable continuous sampling for P95/P99 measurement
Risk: Cost delta spikes after rollout. Mitigation: automatic throttles and immediate rollback trigger, plus an ops play to reduce context length or allocate burst capacity
Risk: Alert fatigue. Mitigation: three-tier alerting with hysteresis and runbook automation for common fixes
